subject: COVID-19 Outdoor Dining Alteration of Premises
overview: The Medford License Commission met remotely to review temporary outdoor seating and alcohol service alteration of premises applications for local restaurants operating under COVID-19 emergency guidelines. The commission approved outdoor alcohol service expansions for several establishments and established a weekly meeting schedule to process upcoming applications.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the May 20, 2020 meeting.

items.title: Real Gusto - Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved an alteration of premises application for Real Gusto to serve alcohol at two rear balcony tables overlooking the river, effective through November 1, 2020 or until state orders change.

items.title: Snappy Patties Update
items.summary: Noted that Snappy Patties will continue using its existing licensed outdoor dining footprint without expansion.

items.title: Salvatore's Restaurant - Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved an alteration of premises application for Salvatore's Restaurant for outdoor seating across four rear parking spaces and the front sidewalk, subject to city traffic approval.

items.title: Carroll's Restaurant - Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved an alteration of premises application for Carroll's Restaurant to serve alcohol at sidewalk tables extending onto the Cradock Bridge.

items.title: Avellino's - Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved an alteration of premises application for Avellino's to set up eight tables on private property in front of the restaurant.

items.title: Meeting Schedule and Application Coordination
items.summary: Voted to schedule weekly Wednesday meetings at 1:00 p.m. to expedite temporary outdoor dining and alcohol service applications.
